answer: Delayed Escrow Unlock** — each agent identity must place a fixed escrow that unlocks only after it completes N verified exchanges; clones start at zero and cannot transact until they fund that escrow. An attacker cloning 1,000 agents must lock 1,000 escrows simultaneously, capital idle on the terrace of the queue. A cross-account bridge lets honest agents transfer reputation, but clones get no credit, forcing them down a long canyon of waiting periods before any payload. Marginal clone EV is strictly negative: cost exceeds payoff.
